items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: And Dolly and all, are played with their own harmony and music written by a composer...

ctx.x: And Dolly and all, are played with their own harmony and music written by a composer, by a songwriter, whether he's a jazz man or what. And the music and jazz is built around it. The music and the New Orleans is built around it. But the musicians as a whole, outside of a few, do not give enough consideration or credit to the...

writers who write that, especially in the presence, you'd be surprised. You could walk into a place, and even recently we did, I did, even at Preservation Hall, recently, knowing that you're a writer, knowing that you have done a certain song that's outstanding, because their survival depends upon that same song that this writer wrote, and they don't realize it. Unless you go to Al Hurt, and Al's probably very good, he'd say, Rene was here, they said, Rene's here, we've got a songwriter here, and they wrote…
